question: Anthracyclines are antitumor agents that have in their structure a fragment of betahydroxycarbonyl able to form complexes with Fe3 +. These complexes reinforce the antitumor action of these drugs because:

options.opa: They favor alkylation reactions of DNA bases.
options.opb: They promote the formation of hydroxyl radicals.
options.opc: They stimulate the depolymerization of microtubules.
options.opd: They favor the intercalation between the DNA bases.
